tasks.title: Author data-driven unit test verifying red-pair dependency order for new modules
acceptance_criteria: Test contains assertions for new-module red-pair bug, non-vacuity regression, and existing-module control
Test passes successfully when run via pytest

spec.objective: Author a data-driven test tests/harness/test_redpair_newmodule_order.py to verify dependency order preservation for new-module oracles.
functional_requirements: Verify that for a new-module red-pair with empty repo_root (absent module), dependencies are preserved (impl depends on oracle, oracle dependencies are empty).
Verify narrowness: if the verification command does not substring-name the oracle test, the dependency direction is flipped (oracle depends on impl).
Verify existing-module control: when the module file is present in the repo_root, the dependency direction is preserved (impl depends on oracle).
edge_cases: Absent module file in a temporary directory
Present module file in a temporary directory
Verification command naming/not naming the oracle test file
non_goals: Integration is out of scope (no integration testing is performed).
spec.implementation_notes: The test must be data-driven (no clock/uuid/random/network/hardcoded keys) and assert the dependencies of normalize_plan results.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: pytest tmp_path directory for temporary files
